text:
marta: Quick heads-up, drafting RN for tonight's EU canary. Need ops + legal ok before internal blast.

marta: Draft RN snippet:
"Redwood API: KV cache warmup improvements cut cold-start token latency by ~30% (p95). Model pinned to v2.1.3 for canary with automatic fallback to v2.0.9 under heavy load. SDK: opt-in auth-header behavior behind feature flag; not enabled by default. Private EU customers: data processed in EU regions per residency settings."

devansh: Expanded bullets for release notes:
- kv-cache: new warmup strategy, exposes warmup metrics (cache_hits, warmup_ms)
- model: pin v2.1.3; fallback v2.0.9
- perf: ~30% improvement on cold-start token latency at p95 in our benchmarks
- sdk: opt-in auth header change, documented and gated by feature flag

kai: Ops ask: propose rollback criteria = error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >1500ms for 3m. Canary plan: start at 5% traffic, hold 10m, ramp to 20% if all green.

lia: Legal: please include that private EU customer processing stays in-region. I can sign off after that's added.

devansh: Deploy command we will run:
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02 --traffic 5% --notes "kv-cache warmup, sdk opt-in auth"
```
We'll have alerts to canary-errors@pager and infra-channel.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02 for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z; queued by marta. Reply with "ACK" to confirm standby.

devansh: ACK — infra monitoring dashboards live, alert rules in place.

kai: SGTM. I'll be on-call for the ramp and will annotate the canary with the checklist tag. I'll run the ramp at +10m if metrics are healthy.

marta: Added legal line: "Private European customers: data processed in EU regions and retained per configured residency settings." Lia, confirm wording.

lia: :thumbsup: wording approved. Legal signs off.

marta: Need a short internal blurb to post ~30m before window to #eng-releases and @eng-oncall. Anyone want to craft?

devansh: One-liner candidate: "Canary: model v2.1.3 (rn-2026-04-02) — 5% traffic in EU -> ramp to 20% if healthy. Oncall: infra/devansh, eng/kai. Rollback if >1.5% errors or p95 >1500ms."

kai: Fine by me. I'll stand by for ramp and monitoring.

marta: I'll update the release-notes doc, schedule the internal announce, and hit deploy-bot 30m before. Tagging @eng-oncall and @ops.

devansh: Ops playbook note to include emergency fallback command:
```
/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9 --reason "canary rollback"
```
Also include steps to force cut traffic and rollback model pin.

marta: Final quick check — everyone OK with RN language and the internal blurb? Reply quick.

kai: OK from eng.

devansh: OK from infra.

lia: Legal signed.

marta: Awesome — scheduling pre-flight ping. :rocket:
